caption: James McNeill Whistler, Turkeys (1880)
alt: An etching on a sheet of laid paper: a courtyard with balconies and hanging vines, a boy standing beside a round well-head, and a flock of turkeys pecking in the foreground. Long straight lines are scored across the whole plate, cancelling it; below, “Turkeys” is written in pencil.
bibliography: Whistler, James McNeill. Turkeys. 1880, etching and drypoint with drypoint cancellation, The Art Institute of Chicago, 1933.705a.
title: Turkeys
